hero.name: Cecil Palmer
hero.specialAbility: For each of your fighters that ends any movement on a multi-zone space that they did not previously occupy at the beginning of their movement, gain 1 Broadcast token.

ruleCards.content:
You have 6 Broadcast tokens. You start the game with all Broadcast tokens face down.

When you declare an attack, you may spend any number of Broadcast tokens to increase your attack range by the same number of spaces.

Effects that refer to "multi-zone spaces" refer to spaces that occupy 2 or more zones.
ruleCards.title: Broadcast tokens

name: Cecil Palmer
note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero cecil-palmer), mirrored from unmatched.cards deck 37z5 “Cecil Palmer” by AndSushi, version OGgotQEeJ “Rework” — the SAME source the engine converted from (data/heroes/cecil-palmer.rules.ts cites it), so every rules-relevant field here is engine-exact. A LAB deck: engine JollyGrin/unbrewed-engine#456 (engine issue #455), so balance and mechanics are not final. ART comes from a DIFFERENT publication of the same deck — the author’s the-unmatched.club 13514, where the thirteen FINISHED full-card renders live (the club’s own 1488x2079 previews from /export/__data.json, not the author’s lower-resolution imgur replacements). Those faces are self-hosted under public/evergreen-decks/art/37z5/ and drawn FULL-BLEED via cardImage; this deck must never fall back to the generated card template, which cannot reproduce the author’s frame, and must never be routed to the art-generation pipeline. The hero card, the BROADCAST TOKENS rule card, the cover and the cardback are mirrored alongside; the board-token portraits are a square crop of the cardback’s eye-and-radio-tower motif (Cecil) and of the author’s Khoshekh illustration (the sidekick). Nothing here is fetched at runtime — the only URL left in this file is the attribution link, and per #665’s rule that link is the AUTHOR’S the-unmatched.club publication (13514), NOT the unmatched.cards mirror the rules text above came from: same deck, same author, but the club is where the finished art this snapshot ships was published, so that is the page the credit sends a reader to. The rules version this snapshot is locked to is still unmatched.cards 37z5 OGgotQEeJ, recorded above and in manifest.json. The two publications agree on all 13 stat tuples and on 30/30 cards; they diverge only in card WORDING (the club’s renders reword three cards) and in the trailing whitespace of one title — the 37z5 payload ends “If you see something, say nothing and drink to forget” with a NON-BREAKING space (U+00A0) where the engine rules file has an ordinary one. The title here is the ENGINE’S, verbatim; art is matched on norm() (lowercase + trim), which strips both, so the two can never disagree (the same quirk Baba Yaga’s “ Iron Teeth” already carries).
